summary: Added FluentAvaloniaUI 2.5.1 to Directory.Packages.props (Avalonia UI ItemGroup) — version requires Avalonia >= 11.3.12, verified compatible with our 11.3.14.

Updated App.axaml: replaced <FluentTheme /> with <sty:FluentAvaloniaTheme /> and added xmlns:sty="using:FluentAvalonia.Styling". FluentAvalonia docs explicitly warn against mixing FluentTheme with FluentAvaloniaTheme (visual artifacts); the theme is a superset and replacement, not an addition.
Created and removed a throwaway _SmokeTestNavView.axaml using <ui:NavigationView /> — compiled with zero 'unknown type' diagnostics.
Final clean build: all 6 projects succeeded with zero errors and zero warnings.

comments.note: Avalonia.Themes.Fluent package reference remains in VideoIndexer.App.csproj but is no longer used — App.axaml now uses FluentAvaloniaTheme exclusively. It is harmless (no warnings emitted) but could be removed as clean-up in a future task.

The DataGrid StyleInclude (avares://Avalonia.Controls.DataGrid/Themes/Fluent.xaml) is retained in App.axaml alongside FluentAvaloniaTheme.
